name: Invalid List for Entanglement or Superposition
hint: Quantum blocks with a possibilities-list input expect a real Scratch list reporter. A number literal or an ordinary variable does not provide a list of possible states and can make the operation unusable.
instruction: Create a Scratch list for the possible states, populate it when needed, and insert its list reporter into the quantum block. Do not use the list name as an ordinary value there.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
entangle [position v] with [Sprite2] possibilities: (1) list: (6) :: #5c068c
